description: Vercel WEB ANALYTICS for one project: page views and unique visitors over a window (default the last 30 days, production traffic), and with `by` a breakdown by requestPath (which pages), referrerHostname (where visitors came from), country, deviceType, osName, browserName, route, utmSource / utmMedium / utmCampaign / utmContent / utmTerm (which campaigns and ads brought them), or a time step (day, week, month). Use it to see which landing pages and ad campaigns actually bring traffic. Needs Web Analytics turned on for the project in Vercel. Read-only, free. Needs Vercel connected (Connectors > Vercel, or connect_connector with an access token).

by.description: one or TWO comma-separated dimensions (at most one time step): requestPath, referrerHostname, country, deviceType, osName, browserName, route, utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmTerm, environment, flags, flags/<key>, hour, day, week, month, year — e.g. 'day,utmCampaign'

filter.description: Vercel's OData filter, e.g. utmSource eq 'facebook'

name: vercel_web_analytics
title: Vercel Web Analytics
